# K8GB - Kubernetes Global Balancer

> Cloud native global load balancing solution for Kubernetes

k8gb is a cloud native Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) solution for Kubernetes. It is a Kubernetes operator that reconciles Gslb resources, updates DNS through ExternalDNS and DNS provider integrations, and serves authoritative answers through an embedded CoreDNS instance, so one hostname resolves to healthy clusters across regions.
